name: Pyromancer: Pyromancy doubles critical damage bonus (#1190)
contract: #1190: Pyromancy 704831 is a family 30 passive, e1 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (163) misc 126 (all schools but physical), BasePoints 99 = +100%. Aura 163 has a no-op handler and is read in Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus (Unit.cpp:9943) via GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscMask, then AddPct(crit_bonus, crit_mod) (Unit.cpp:9952). Explode 800792 is Fire (mask 0x4), DmgClass 1 (magic), so the core crit bonus on a 1000 base is 1500 and +100% makes it 3000, a delta of +1500. spell_critical_damage calculates a critical hit from a fixed base of 1000 through that function. The +1500 assumes a clean character with no other crit-damage source (group report caveat); the assertion is a delta against a snapshot taken before learning the passive.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Explode critical hit from a base of 1000 before Pyromancy
Pyromancy adds 1500 to the critical hit of a 1000 base
Unlearning Pyromancy restores the base critical damage
